signal: Searchspring joined Klevu and Intelligent Reach to form Athos Commerce, with general availability of the unified platform planned for Q1 2026

email.subject1: a signal play for Athos Commerce
email.body1:
Zachary, saw Searchspring joined Klevu to form Athos Commerce, with the unified platform going GA in Q1 2026.

A merger like that creates a flood of cross-sell and net-new accounts faster than signals can be turned into action. Our AI SDR closes that signal-to-action latency, researching, writing, and following up autonomously: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new hires.

I built a personalized signal play for Athos Commerce off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Zachary, quick follow-up for Athos Commerce.

Merging two go-to-motions usually means messy data and slow follow-up before the combined funnel settles. As RevOps, you feel that signal-to-action gap first, and it's hard to show measurable lift while the systems are still merging.

Want 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I'd change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Zachary, last bit of proof for Athos Commerce.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Athos Commerce's reply rate likely compares to other ecommerce software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Zachary, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action without adding headcount isn't a priority while the Athos platform goes GA, no problem at all. A merger and a launch at once is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a RevOps motion? I'll tailor it to Athos Commerce either way.
